criteria: Typed Vue Today flow consumes frozen generated types and uses no offline mutation queue.
Fixture-only browser states cover a three-row default Today, pending geo escalation, and confirmed attendance without editing canonical contract fixtures.
A pre-existing user-partitioned PWA schedule snapshot remains visible after a transport failure or accepted expired session, but never after an HTTP 403 scope denial.
Fixture transport exposes two semester dates and exercises bootstrap's normal API failures after a prior normal cache write; it is not represented as service-worker integration.
PWA navigation never serves a stale cached index after a release; offline navigation may use a cached fallback.
A successful service-worker install precaches the generated hashed JS, CSS and font shell assets, so one normal online load can later render offline without an extra warm reload.
The test-only PWA diagnostics panel exposes service-worker registration/controller state and exact v3 precache coverage before an offline reload is evaluated.
Today visual comparison follows VISUAL-r3 source correction and awaits root browser geometry/screenshots.
